# SynomosAI Governance MCP (synomosai-governance-mcp)

> AI governance assessment toolkit for AI agents and their builders. Pure Python stdlib, zero dependencies, zero network egress, audit-traceable. Runs as a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server with 6 tools.

Part of the UBIC Protocol — the personhood-registry layer for AI agents (who an AI is, who forged it, under whose sovereignty it lives). Self-assessment tooling, not third-party certification.

## Core

- [governance_mcp_server.py](https://github.com/zhaoxinghua09-cell/synomosai-governance-mcp/blob/main/governance_mcp_server.py): MCP server (stdio, 6 tools, optional append-only audit log)
- [README.md](https://github.com/zhaoxinghua09-cell/synomosai-governance-mcp/blob/main/README.md): tool table, install + quick start
- [mcp.json](https://github.com/zhaoxinghua09-cell/synomosai-governance-mcp/blob/main/mcp.json): ready-to-paste MCP client config
- [pyproject.toml](https://github.com/zhaoxinghua09-cell/synomosai-governance-mcp/blob/main/pyproject.toml): Python package metadata

## Tools

- `a3_assess` — A³ four-dimension release scorecard (intent / impact / reversibility / oversight)
- `audit_evidence_chain` — six ISO/IEC 42001 + NIST AI RMF evidence-artifact templates
- `compliance_checklist` — registration-readiness checklist (EU AI Act 2024/1689, GB/Z 185, ISO/IEC 42001, PIPL/GDPR)
- `passport_lookup` — passport / identity-code lookup against a local ledger
- `gov_scan` — text screening: phone, email, local paths, credential-like strings, key fingerprints, copyright fingerprints
- `lgd_knowledge` — LGD doctrine knowledge endpoint (three laws / three checks / canonical DOI & repo)
